findings: Per-gallery-mesh descriptor copy changes only bGenerateMeshlets when medium exists and bAirContributor is true. Shared descriptor and ordinary/host mesh behavior remain unchanged.
Host parser sets bAirContributor=false for mediumMode=host, so Stage3 glass keeps prior loader behavior.
GenerateMeshlets writes only auxiliary meshlets/meshletVertices/meshletTriangles; original indices passed as const unsigned int*, original positions as const float*.
meshopt_optimizeMeshlet receives auxiliary vertex remap and local triangle bytes only, not original index/position arrays.
bOptimize remains false, so the following meshopt_optimizeVertexCache mutation is not invoked. LOD count remains1 and original normal/transform/material declarations are unchanged.
limitations: Source review only; no new GPU/loader readback by reviewer. Nonzero actual runtime meshlets and image recovery are separate validation.
